working_definition: Epithelial cells of the adult pylorus (anterior hindgut, where Malpighian tubules arise) from the gut analysis (Li et al. 2022; author term FBbt:00100784).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any epithelial cell (FBbt:00000124) that is part of some adult hindgut epithelium (FBbt:00047168).

justification: FBbt has no pylorus-specific cell term; the pylorus is the anterior portion of the adult hindgut, so adult hindgut epithelial cell is the most specific cell-level parent.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Anterior portion of the adult hindgut. It is a constriction from which the Malpighian tubules arise.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Organ-region term, not a cell term.
